snippet.title: Sunset Bike Racer - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Have you got what it takes to be the best motocross driver?
Turn the key, kick the starter and push the limit of your bike racing skills.

Stand your trial in this crazy offroad adventure!

You can PLAY NOW ON ..

.. GOOGLE Play (Android): 
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.kamptner.sunsetracer

.. WINDOWS (Phone, Desktop, Laptop):
http://apps.microsoft.com/windows/en-us/app/ef91f7ef-edbb-43c7-b1f7-2dbc6290b9dc

.. APPLE iPhone, iPad:
https://itunes.apple.com/app/id1190945215

.. TIZEN Phones:
Search for "Sunset BIke Racer" on your Tizen Phone

.. BLACKBERRY:
http://appworld.blackberry.com/webstore/content/59989446

BEHIND THE SCENES:
Have you ever wondered how a game like Sunset Bike Racer is made?
See for yourself: https://youtu.be/lJoRhvAlEfY

Want to find out more?
http://games.kamptner.net/sunsetracer

Thank you for watching and best regards,
your Sunset Bike Racer developer.
